subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our Exclusive Summer Sale, offering up to 50% off on select items. Don't miss this opportunity to upgrade your wardrobe for the summer season. Visit our website or stop by our store to shop the latest trends at unbeatable prices. Hurry, as the sale is for a limited time only! Thank you for being a loyal customer. Happy shopping!
